title: Tour with an amazing Guide
text: We had a very good tour. Our Guide Laura was amazing. She is extremely learned in the architectural and historical background of the Cathedral. Time flew on her tour and we came out enriched and enchanted
author: SunilMittal09

title: A visit of 10
text: Our experience in the visit to the Cathedral of Seville was a 10/10. From the way I told it and the way I did it, it has been super enjoyable. We will revert to her for future visits. Greetings❤️
author: andreagil26

title: Best guide in sevilla!!
text: Laura knows everything about the history from sevilla and the cathedral. She speaks very good english and is very enthousiastic and happy to explain everything to us. With this tour you see much more details. she gave all the answers to our questions and also recommend restaurants and other interesting places in sevilla. For sure we recommend a tour with Laura it's worth it!
author: El C

title: Ease of accessing the tour
text: Guide with versatility and dynamism, resolving any question or doubt, very clear in his explanations, highly recommended
